system.description: Select up to a number of targets equal to your Arcana. Those targets roll Magykal Resistance. On failure they are brought into a Magnitude 4 area that exists outside of the confines of normal space, removing them from the current engagement. Creatures in this space can not interact with creatures outside of it and vice versa. They remain in that space for a number of Rounds equal to the additional Stamina paid. At the end of those Rounds the targets are returned to the engagement.
